break_derivation.mechanism: Mortgage Tech goodwill ($17.6B) impairs and a TXSE/Kalshi-led exchange-share loss plus EMIR-3 clearing migration permanently cut owner-FCF, with the multiple compressing to a distressed level.
break_derivation.reference: Mortgage Tech GAAP operating income went negative in FY23 (-276) and FY24 (-170) (pack sec.2), a franchise stress event; one such break in the ~5y window shown.
break_derivation.adjustment_pp: +0pp to the ~1-in-5y reference ~20%/5y, scaled to 12% over 10y given diversification across Exchanges/FIDS; set 12%.

Company-total base grown by the seat's path, discounted, Gordon terminal, /566M shares, plus net-debt per share -$33.18 (net debt $18,779M /566M, sec.5).

break_derivation.mechanism: Incremental ROIC collapses below the cost of capital as Black Knight synergies stall and mortgage-tech volumes stay depressed, so deployed capital destroys value and FCF falls.
break_derivation.reference: Black Knight deal measured against capital deployed shows incremental ROIC with amort add-back of only 8.3% (pack sec.6), already below a 10% hurdle; a franchise-break extension of that.
break_derivation.adjustment_pp: Reference deployed-capital ROIIC 8.3% signals strain; set break 12% over 10y (above 10% floor) given otherwise strong 60%+ exchange margins.

break_derivation.mechanism: Terminal growth proves unsustainable: moat erosion plus a succession misstep cut ROE-driven reinvestment returns, FCF declines and the terminal multiple compresses.

break_derivation.adjustment_pp: FY22 ROE collapse was driven by one-off investee losses, not a franchise break; discount that to a 12% permanent-break probability over 10y.
